tasks.title: The ExitPlanMode approval hook writes a digest-bound marker
tasks.objective: Add a PostToolUse hook on ExitPlanMode that writes .factory/plan-approval.json (plan digest, approver, timestamp) ONLY when the human approves the plan, and nothing when it is rejected or edited.
acceptance_criteria: A new factory/scripts/plan_approval_hook.py runs as a PostToolUse hook matching ExitPlanMode, wired in .claude/settings.json alongside the existing PreToolUse and Stop hooks.
On a hook payload representing an APPROVED ExitPlanMode, it writes .factory/plan-approval.json with plan_sha256 (sha256 of the plan content it was shown), an approver, and an ISO timestamp.
On a payload representing a REJECTED or edited ExitPlanMode, it writes no marker and leaves any existing one untouched.
.factory/plan-approval.json is gitignored as ephemeral per-worktree working state (decision 0025).
The hook fails closed: a malformed payload writes no marker rather than a false one, and never raises in a way that blocks the tool.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "plan_approval or approval_hook or exitplanmode"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The one thing that matters: the marker is written ONLY on genuine human approval. If the hook writes on presentation, rejection, or a malformed payload, an agent could mint its own approval — the exact hole this story closes. Verify the approval-result key it reads is the real Claude Code PostToolUse signal, not an assumption, and that fail-closed means no marker.

tasks.title: plan save requires a fresh matching marker; CLI fallback for headless
tasks.objective: Make forge plan save set awaiting-approval and refuse approved unless a fresh .factory/plan-approval.json matches the plan body digest, add a human-attributed forge plan approve --by fallback, and document the plan-mode approval step — every existing plan-save gate preserved.
acceptance_criteria: plan save digests the plan BODY (excluding the machine-added frontmatter, using the existing body/header split), reads .factory/plan-approval.json, and sets plan_status approved ONLY when a marker exists and its plan_sha256 matches the body digest.

With no marker, or a marker whose digest does not match (an edit after approval), plan save writes the plan as awaiting-approval and refuses to approve, with a message naming the missing plan-mode approval.
Implementation stays blocked: update_run refuses the implementing phase while plan_status is awaiting-approval, unchanged in mechanism (it already requires approved).
forge plan approve --by <name> writes a human-attributed marker for the current plan's body digest; it is refused without --by. This is the documented headless fallback.

Every existing plan-save gate runs first and unchanged: grill freshness, decisions_reviewed coverage, contradiction signals, and the Surface Impact section check. Their existing tests stay green with no weakening.
factory/prompts/planner.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md describe the plan-mode approval step and the CLI fallback.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "plan_save or plan_approve or awaiting or plan_gate"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That the digest is over the BODY the human approved, not the file with its machine frontmatter — otherwise the bind never matches and the gate is either always-open or always-closed. And that NO existing plan-save gate was weakened to make the new flow pass: a relaxed grill/decisions/contradiction check is a blocking finding. The fallback must be genuinely human-attributed (refused without --by), or it reopens the self-approval hole.
